`final class Transformation`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.render.transform` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Transformation.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/render/transform/Transformation.java)

A list of translations, rotations and scales applied to the model-view matrix around what you draw.

## Description

Build it once, then apply it around your drawing:

```java fragment
final Transformation tilt = Transformation.create().rotate(() -> this.angle, Rotation.ROLL, Vector.create(60D, 20D));
tilt.apply(() -> DrawUtils.SHAPE.drawRect(0D, 0D, 120D, 40D, Color.decode("#5B8CFF")));
```

The operations run in the order you add them, and the suppliers are read each time the transformation is applied, so a transformation can follow a value that changes.
A translation also tells the pixel grid how far the drawing moved, so that a moving node stays sharp.
A node effect transforms a node; reach for this class in your own drawing.

<a id="Transformation-method-apply"></a>

### apply

`void apply()` 

Pushes the model-view matrix and applies the operations; call `reset()` after your drawing to pop it.

`void apply(Runnable drawing)` 

Applies the operations around `drawing`, then restores the model-view matrix, even when `drawing` throws.

<a id="Transformation-method-reset"></a>

### reset

`void reset()` 

Pops the model-view matrix pushed by `apply()`.

<a id="Transformation-method-transform"></a>

### transform

`void transform(double pivotX, double pivotY)` 

Applies the operations to the current model-view matrix without pushing it, with `pivotX`, `pivotY` as the pivot of the operations that have none.

<a id="Transformation-method-clear"></a>

### clear

`void clear()`
